description.summary: The Stanhope bed provides a spacious King sleeping surface supported by a convenient hydraulic storage mechanism. This King size frame is also available in a Queen size option to suit varying room layouts. Finished in Urban Grey, this piece is also offered in Baltic Blue, Shitake Beige, and Sienna Brown, providing a neutral foundation that anchors a contemporary bedroom retreat.
